neighbours.label: the reverse or opposite side of a two-way relation (the inverse of, outward versus inward)
fire: Division is simply the inverse of multiplication.
Outward migration rose while inward migration fell.
Debt is the inverse of savings in this simple model.
Inbound flights were full, but outbound flights were empty.
Exhaling is the inverse of inhaling.
The inverse of a rotation turns the shape back again.
Imports rose while exports went the other way.
Selling is the reverse of buying in this ledger.
quiet: Division is usually taught in the third year of school.
Migration rose sharply during the last decade.
Debt grew quickly in this simple model.
The flights were full during the holiday season.
Breathing slowly can help calm the nerves.
A rotation turns the shape around its centre.
Imports rose during the first quarter of the year.
Selling became much easier with the new ledger.

notes: Weak and varied top examples. Probes: 'the inverse of imports' 0.32, 'outward investment' 0.26, French 'l'inverse de' 0.43; 'other side of the river' 0.06.
